issue: séngʷs is AOR.2SG of séngʷt 'sink', but the English 'they go under the water' needs 3pl (séngʷn̥t / sengʷónti); person and number mismatch.
dóru ḱénesi? uses the subjunctive of 'climb' for 'can you climb a tree?'; ability is not expressed, a stretched sense.
déh₂nu éti for 'beyond the river': éti is an adverb 'beyond, further, also'; as a postposition with the accusative it is a stretched sense.
méǵʰye ḱóm 'with me' uses the DAT.SG pronoun with ḱóm; elsewhere ḱóm takes the instrumental. Closed-class pronouns have no instrumental cell (engine gap).
póntoh₁m̥ follows the lexicon's póntoh₁s; the usual reconstruction is *pónteh₂s / acc. *póntoh₂m̥ (notation of the laryngeal).
ǵérh₂onth₁e is NOM/ACC.DU 'two old men', used as the recipient of dh₃dʰí 'give'; English 'to the old men' needs DAT.PL (ǵérh₂ontbʰos/-mos). Case and number of an athematic noun in an oblique role.
tr̥syétes is PRS.2DU/3DU of tr̥syéti, but the English is 'I am thirsty' (1sg tr̥syóh₂). Person and number mismatch.
suHnúbʰos is DAT/ABL.PL of suHnús, used as the address 'Son'; needs VOC.SG súHnew. Case and number wrong.
bʰéwdʰōh₂? is SBJV.1SG 'shall I stay awake?', but the English and the reply ('I shall stay awake') need 2sg 'will you stay awake?' (bʰéwdʰesi). Person mismatch.
bʰoréyōh₂ is the iterative 'carry around' for plain 'I shall carry'; stretched sense.
